items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: Him and big old Ernest. ... Ernest Kelly. Ernest Kelly. Ernest Kelly, he was soft too? Yeah. He big Kelly, but he couldn't go loud.

ctx.x: He was a good clarinet player. He was a good clarinet player. He was a good clarinet player. But I remember Freddie Buh-Boo. Huh? Trombone player. Who? Freddie Buh-Boo. He was a player of the Liberty Bells. He couldn't do himself nothing.
Him and big old Ernest. What ass he at now? He did. He was standing up and yelling and playing. He couldn't hear him playing back there.
He was playing soft pedal trombone. He couldn't hear him hear nothing. Him and Ernest, who?
